第1568章 弯弓射金乌3（第1页）
所有人都震撼，眼前这一幕怎么可能是真的？魔族地仙强者只是两个回合便要被斩杀了吗？
大家不敢相信真是真的，可这偏偏就是真的。
只有杨凡等人才知道大鹏王的强大之处，同级别他是无敌的，当然此时此刻大鹏王之所以能够取得压倒性优势也是有原因的，第一，魔族地仙强者轻敌，第二，大鹏王则是蓄势全力一击，爆发出最强战力要将其斩首，第三，第一击落于下风之后再想要反击就十分困难了。
所以，才有了现在魔族地仙强者要被大鹏王斩首的一幕。
“哼”。眼看大鹏王就要成功，一道冷笑声传递而出，在大鹏王的上方神光涌动，出现了一道神圣之门，那神圣之门洞开，一名身材伟岸，周围环绕神环的中年男子迈步而出，朝着大鹏王一拳轰杀而去。
大鹏王若是执意斩杀魔族地仙强者必然会遭遇重创甚至被突然出现的这尊强者给击杀，这是神族的地仙强者，也出现了。
大鹏王皱了皱眉头，最终选择退避，与这名神族地仙强者对轰了一记，而后抽身撤退了出去，大鹏王知道，刚刚那一击没有斩杀掉魔族地仙强者，再想要将对方击杀便难如登天了，不会给他第二次那么好的机会，他心中不由微微一叹。
“该死，你到底是谁？竟然让我魔狂天吃了这么一个大的亏”。魔族的地仙强者大声咆哮起来，眼睛阴森森的，他的实力本来不至于如此憋屈，但是一开始的大意让他吃了极大的亏。
神族的地仙强者说道，“我若是猜测不错，你应该是妖族大鹏王吧？”。
妖族大鹏王，九死一生进入混沌之门内得到了逆天机缘，从此之后便走上了逆天之路，这是大家都知道的事情，万族甚至有不少人想杀大鹏王夺取大鹏王的机缘。
但现在大鹏王现世，众人才知道，这尊存在竟然如此的可怕，差点斩了魔族地仙魔狂天，真是太让人震惊了，一般人去找大鹏王晦气那不是去送死吗？
就算是魔族地仙魔狂天也吃惊，没有想到眼前便是那尊妖族的大鹏王，他脸上露出诧异的神色来，“原来是你，你到底在混沌之门内得到了何种机缘竟然让你在如此短暂的时间之内修为提升到了现在这种地步，真是太让人吃惊了”。
他舔了舔嘴唇，“你的机缘，我很有兴趣”。
神族地仙呵呵一笑，“这种机缘谁不想要？大鹏王，我们万族不来找你的麻烦你却主动来送死了，真是活的不耐烦了，不灭战体家族的老不死，还不速速出来，我们三人一起联手将这大鹏王给做掉”。
一道苍老的声音传出，下一刻，虚空之中出现了一座旋涡，那旋涡之中迈步走出了一名老者，那老者干瘦如材，半截身子像是入了土，身上散发着一种腐朽的气息，随时随地都要死掉似得，这老者是不灭战体家族的老祖，如今他也出现了，这不灭战体家族与杨凡的仇怨不小。
“不好”。火鸦道人神色微微一变，看到三尊地仙围攻大鹏王，他要赶来救援，但是金乌族的地仙却拦住了火鸦道人，金乌族地仙冷笑连连“你的对手是我，去往哪里？”
他长啸天地，打出无量神通朝着火鸦道人轰杀而去。

他地仙级别的修为想要牵扯住火鸦道人，火鸦道人想要立马脱身也并不容易的。
“动手吧，做掉他”。神族地仙出声说道。
他与魔族地仙，不灭战体家族地仙迅速达成了一致，三人全部出手，分为三个方向朝着大鹏王轰杀而去。

Chapter 1568 Bow Shooting the Golden Crow 3 (Page 1)
Everyone was shocked. How could this scene in front of them be real? Will the powerful demon earth immortal be killed in just two rounds?
Everyone can't believe it is true, but it is true.
Only Yang Fan and others know the power of King Dapeng. He is invincible at the same level. Of course, there are reasons why King Dapeng can gain an overwhelming advantage at this moment. First, the powerful demon earth immortal underestimates the enemy. Second, King Dapeng is preparing to attack with all his strength, bursting out the strongest combat power to behead him. Third, after the first blow is at a disadvantage, it is very difficult to counterattack.
Therefore, there is a scene where the powerful demon earth immortal is about to be beheaded by King Dapeng.
"snort". Seeing that King Dapeng was about to succeed, a sneer came out. Divine light surged above King Dapeng, and a sacred door appeared. The sacred door opened, and a middle-aged man with a tall figure and a divine ring around him stepped out and punched King Dapeng to kill him.
If King Dapeng insists on killing the powerful Earth Immortal of the Demon Clan, he will definitely suffer heavy losses and even be killed by this powerful man who suddenly appears. This is the powerful Earth Immortal of the God Clan who also appears.
King Dapeng frowned, and finally chose to retreat. He exchanged blows with the strong man from the God Clan, and then withdrew. King Dapeng knew that if the attack just now did not kill the strong man from the Demon Clan, it would be extremely difficult to kill him. He would not be given such a good chance a second time. He couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
"Damn it, who are you? You actually made me, Mo Kuangtian, suffer such a big loss." The powerful Earth Immortal of the Demon Race roared loudly, his eyes were gloomy. His strength would not have meant he was so aggrieved, but his carelessness at the beginning caused him to suffer a great loss.
The powerful Earth Immortal from the God Clan said, "If my guess is correct, you should be the Dapeng King of the Demon Clan, right?".
The Demon Clan's Dapeng King narrowly escaped death and entered the Gate of Chaos to gain a heaven-defying opportunity. From then on, he embarked on a path that defies the heavens. This is something that everyone knows. Many people from all races even want to kill Dapeng King and seize the chance of Dapeng King.
But now that the Dapeng King has appeared in this world, everyone knows that this existence is so terrifying. It almost killed the demon clan, the earthly immortal, the demon Kuang Tian, ​​which is really shocking. For most people, if they go to find the Dapeng King to bring bad luck, wouldn't they be willing to die?
Even Demon Clan Demon Kuangtian was surprised. He did not expect that the Demon Clan's Dapeng King was in front of him. A surprised look appeared on his face, "So it's you. What kind of opportunity did you get in the Gate of Chaos that allowed you to improve your cultivation to this level in such a short period of time? It's really surprising."
He licked his lips and said, "I'm very interested in your opportunity."
The Earth Immortal of the God Clan chuckled, "Who wouldn't want this kind of opportunity? King Dapeng, we tribes don't come to trouble you, but you take the initiative to die. I'm really impatient. If the old Immortal of the Immortal War Body Family doesn't come out quickly, the three of us will join forces to kill this Dapeng King."
An old voice came out, and the next moment, a vortex appeared in the void, and an old man stepped out of the vortex. The old man was as skinny as a stick, and half of his body seemed to have been buried in the ground. He exuded a rotten aura, as if he was going to die anytime, anywhere. This old man is the ancestor of the Immortal War Body family, and now he has also appeared. The Immortal War Body family has a lot of grudges with Yang Fan.
"not good". Taoist Fire Crow's expression changed slightly. When he saw three Earth Immortals besieging King Dapeng, he rushed to rescue him, but the Earth Immortal from the Golden Crow tribe stopped Taoist Fire Crow. The Earth Immortal from the Golden Crow tribe sneered again and again: "Your opponent is me, go therewhere? "
He roared to the heaven and earth, using his infinite magical powers to blast towards Taoist Huo Yao.
If his cultivation at the Earth Immortal level wants to involve Taoist Huo Yao, it will not be easy for Taoist Huo Yao to escape immediately.
"Go ahead and kill him." The Earth Immortal of the God Clan spoke up.
He quickly reached an agreement with the Demon Clan Earth Immortal and the Immortal Fighting Body Clan Earth Immortal. All three of them took action and blasted towards King Dapeng in three directions.
